summary.text: Loren Selig is a Democratic state representative for New Hampshire House of Representatives Strafford 10 who took office in December 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. She is a realtor and former English teacher who lives in Durham.

paragraphs.text: Selig graduated from Newark Academy in 1988, earned a B.A. in English and education from Clark University in 1991, and earned an M.A.T. in education from Johns Hopkins University in 1996.
Her career experience includes working as a realtor with Arthur Thomas Properties, a sales agent with Keller Williams Coastal Realty, and an English teacher with Howard County Public Schools.
She has served on the board of Temple Israel of Portsmouth.
Selig was one of four Democrats who advanced from the 2022 Democratic primary for Strafford 10, a four-seat district, and she advanced again in the 2024 and 2026 Democratic primaries.
For the 2023-2024 session she was assigned to the Criminal Justice and Public Safety Committee.
